resources.string: One API for every AI app and device: this phone serves your providers, subscriptions and routing (OpenAI, Anthropic and Gemini formats) to its own apps, WeiAssist included, and to the devices on its network. Other devices need a gateway key, made in the console.
Not in this build for this phone\'s processor
Network: not on a local network

To keep serving after the phone restarts or this app updates, allow it to auto-launch and run in the background: on many phones that is off until you turn it on in the app\'s settings (Battery, or Auto launch). Otherwise, open this app once to start it again.
